notes: DeezToken: fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 (IMDeezNutz, DEEZ, 18 decimals), no constructor arguments, whole supply minted once to msg.sender (the launch factory). No owner, mint, burn, pause, blocklist or proxy; the only addition is a timestamp checkpoint of every balance (Checkpoints.Trace208) so rewards can be weighted by actual balances. DeezHook constructor: (IPoolManager poolManager_ = $poolManager, address token_ = $token, address pairedCurrency_ = IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7). It has no owner argument: nothing in this launch has an owner or admin, so $owner only receives the policy's 2% payer share. The hook's constructor deploys two further contracts, DeezRewards (hook.rewards()) and DeezLiquidityLock (hook.liquidityLock()). Permissions match getHookPermissions exactly: beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta (flags 0x20CC); no liquidity or donate callbacks, so the factory's zero-liquidity fee collect is never intercepted. beforeInitialize accepts only the PoolManager as caller and only the first pool whose currencies are {DEEZ, IMD}; it accepts any fee tier and tick spacing, so pool.fee 12500 (the launch policy's 1.25% LP fee, split 80/20 payer/network) and tickSpacing 60 are accepted; the hook's 2% comes on top of the LP fee. Fee: FEE_BPS = 200, exactly 2.00% of the IMD side of every buy and sell (exact-input and exact-output), never taken from DEEZ. On the specified side it is returned from beforeSwap, on the unspecified side from afterSwap, and in afterSwap it is minted to the hook as an ERC-6909 claim (poolManager.mint), so no token balance in the PoolManager is needed and a buy on the freshly seeded pool cannot revert. The brief asks for rewards in IMD, so the fee is kept and paid in IMD rather than sold for ETH. harvest() (anyone) unlocks the manager, burns the claims, moves the IMD into DeezRewards and credits the current daily epoch. DeezRewards: claimable(account, epoch) = pot[epoch] x balanceAt(account, epoch snapshot) / eligibleSupply, where eligibleSupply excludes the PoolManager (where the pool's DEEZ lives), 0x...dEaD, the hook and the distributor; claim(account, epochs) is permissionless and nonReentrant; recycle(epoch) folds unclaimed IMD into the current pot after 365 epochs. DeezLiquidityLock: anyone can send DEEZ and/or IMD and call lock() to mint a permanent full-range, sell-side or buy-wall position with no remove function; the requester locks at least 10,000,000 DEEZ of the 2% there after launch. Every callback and both unlockCallbacks require msg.sender == poolManager. pool.initialPrice is written as the launch facts give it; the deployer derives the opening price from the policy's 2,500 IMD opening market cap and the currency order. Supply, split and allocations are the factory's and are not manifest fields.
